normalization: NFKC, Unicode casefold, whitespace collapsed, outer whitespace stripped; applied only to separate normalized export
raw_notes: Exact extracted logical cell text, including whitespace; null, empty string and whitespace-only distinguished
numbers: Excluded from lexical frequency counts; preserved in raw and normalized notes
ngrams: Unigrams and adjacent bigrams within alphabetic punctuation-delimited segments; reject grams with stopwords or one-character tokens; do not join tokens over deletions
frequency_unit: One candidate note; document frequency counts each term at most once per note
sorting: Descending document frequency, descending term frequency, ascending term
denominators: All selected candidate rows including missing notes; nonempty document counts also supplied
scope: Only final-human-reviewed statistical_results candidates with confirmed_issue, retained disposition, and original S_C/S_W relationship: 139 confirmed statistical notes and the overlapping 37 confirmed-substantive notes. No preprocessing or lexical mining of other candidates. Excludes protocol_report, report_internal_inconsistency, and plan_material. Descriptive vocabulary only; no topics, errors, or categories inferred from keyword frequencies
independence: Candidate notes cluster within papers; no independent-document statistical inference performed
